# Downstream boundary-request amendment — r0.5

Status: normative closure amendment

Every signal product binds exact MAP and template boundary identities. NOI and
FLT-to-FRUIT named uses each record exactly one state:

'not_requested', 'inapplicable', 'unavailable', 'compatible',
'requested_pending', or 'realized_child_exists'.

Base signal publication does not require a child. A child never mutates its
parent signal. PA, SA, SP, CU, NU, RU, and FH remain separately addressable;
an optional unrequested role cannot block an unrelated signal role.
